findings.claim: The Surreal projection serializer can write delete operations but the deserializer rejects them, making any persisted delete change unreadable.
findings.evidence: `op_name` maps `ChangeOp::Delete` to `"delete"`, while `parse_op` only accepts `"insert"`, `"update"`, and `"upsert"` and returns `InvalidData` for every other value; acceptance criterion 4 requires delete semantics for the v1 entity path.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `"delete" => Ok(ChangeOp::Delete)` to `parse_op`, or reject delete changes before persisting rows if deletes must never be stored.
